name: Dynamic Workflows Prompt Pack 📝
description_md:
# What You Get

- 
The Prompt Pack PDF: a clean, copy-paste guide that teaches the five anchors of a great workflow prompt, then walks through every prompt with when to use it, the exact text, the guardrails, and what good output looks like.

- 
The Data Room Prompts: the two prompts from the demo. One for a ranked risk audit across a folder of contracts, and one for needle-in-a-haystack discovery that hunts for side letters, related-party deals, and documents that contradict each other.

- 
The Proposal Factory Prompt: turn one client list and a template into a folder of finished, personalized, on-brand proposals, each one checked by a reviewer agent before it saves.

- 
The Compliance Sweep Prompt: check a pile of documents against a new standard, one reviewer per file, every gap challenged before it makes the report.

- 
12 Industry Prompts: the same move ready to paste for law, finance, healthcare, insurance, real estate, software, marketing, recruiting, compliance, research, support, and government.

- 
The Build-Your-Own Template: the fill-in-the-blanks pattern behind every prompt, plus a worked example, so you can write a workflow for anything

This pack is free. If it saves you a week of work, come say hi in the community!
